$sources: NCh 433 Of.1996 Mod.2009 with DS 61 (2011): 4.2-4.3 (zones, categories), 5.9 (drift), 6.2 (static method: Cmin, Cmax), 6.3 (modal method: the spectrum Sa = S A0 α / (R*/I), α, R*), Tables 5.1 (R, R0), 6.1 (I), 6.2 (A0), 6.3 (S, T0, T', n, p), 6.4 (Cmax); see VERIFY.md
source: NCh 433 Mod.2009 + DS 61: Sa = S A0 α(T) / (R*/I), α = (1 + 4.5 (T/T0)^p) / (1 + (T/T0)^3), R* = 1 + T / (0.10 T0 + T/R0), Cmin = A0 S / 6g ≤ C ≤ Cmax S A0 / g; by the generic shapeFactors spectrum method (A0/g, I as Z, I; R0 as μ; α as the shape with its divisor; S as the soil factor; kμ = R* by the periodRatio form, at the period itself). The static method takes the same spectrum at the building's period (NCh 433's static C = 2.75 S A0 (T'/T*)^n / (g R) is not built: SAEngine practice, VERIFY.md C14). Entered from knowledge of the standard, every value to be checked against the printed standard and decree (VERIFY.md).

A.description: Soil type A: rock, cemented soil (vs30 above 900 m/s; S 0.90, T0 0.15 s, T' 0.20 s, n 1.00, p 2.0)

B.description: Soil type B: soft or fractured rock, very dense or very firm soil (vs30 500-900 m/s; S 1.00, T0 0.30 s, T' 0.35 s, n 1.33, p 1.5)

C.description: Soil type C: dense or firm soil (vs30 350-500 m/s; S 1.05, T0 0.40 s, T' 0.45 s, n 1.40, p 1.6)

D.description: Soil type D: medium dense or medium firm soil (vs30 180-350 m/s; S 1.20, T0 0.75 s, T' 0.85 s, n 1.80, p 1.0)

E.description: Soil type E: soft soil (vs30 below 180 m/s; S 1.30, T0 1.20 s, T' 1.35 s, n 1.80, p 1.0)
